questions.question: Who won the National Award for Best Actor in Leading Role at the 71st National Film Awards 2025?

options.text: Shah Rukh Khan and Vikrant Massey

questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Shah Rukh Khan and Vikrant Massey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shah Rukh Khan** is a globally recognized actor and producer, often referred to as the "King of Bollywood". He is known for his exceptional performances across genres.
 
• **Vikrant Massey** is one of the most talented actors in Indian cinema, known for his versatile roles in films and web series. His acting prowess has garnered critical acclaim in recent years.
 
• The **71st National Film Awards** is a prestigious event in India that honors the best in Indian cinema across various categories. It is organized by the **Directorate of Film Festivals** under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
 
• The Best Actor award in a Leading Role recognizes outstanding performances that contribute significantly to the film’s narrative and overall impact.
 
• This joint win by **Shah Rukh Khan and Vikrant Massey** reflects their impactful performances in their respective films, showcasing their versatility and ability to connect with audiences.
 
• Both actors have been praised for their ability to portray complex characters, adding depth and realism to their roles, making their win a testament to their skill and dedication to the craft of acting.
 
• The recognition at the National Film Awards cements their place among the finest actors in Indian cinema and inspires upcoming actors to strive for excellence.

questions.question: Which country has announced that only climbers who have previously summited a peak above 7,000 meters will be allowed to climb Everest?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Government of Nepal** has announced new eligibility rules for those attempting to climb **Mount Everest**.
 
• Under the revised policy, only climbers who have **successfully summited a peak above 7,000 meters** will be allowed to climb Everest.
 
• This move is aimed at improving safety standards and **reducing the number of inexperienced climbers** attempting the dangerous ascent.
 
• The decision comes in the wake of multiple deaths and overcrowding incidents witnessed during recent climbing seasons.
 
• Authorities are also looking to introduce stricter checks on climbers’ health and ensure **adequate insurance and trained support staff**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mount Everest**, standing at 8,848.86 meters, lies on the Nepal-Tibet border and is the world’s highest mountain.
 
• Nepal earns significant revenue through climbing permits, with each Everest permit costing around **USD 11,000**.
 
• In the 2023 spring season, Nepal issued a record number of over 460 Everest permits, leading to **dangerous overcrowding**.
 
• The recent change aligns with calls from international mountaineering bodies for **better regulation of high-altitude climbing**.
 
• Nepal is also working on improving **rescue infrastructure and weather forecasting systems** to prevent climbing disasters.

questions.question: Who won the Chess Esports World Cup (EWC) 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Magnus Carlsen**__.

questions.question: Where was the Trilateral Summit 2025 of WHO, WIPO, and WTO held?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Geneva, Switzerland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Trilateral Summit 2025** was a high-level meeting involving three major international organizations: **WHO (World Health Organization)**, **WIPO (World Intellectual Property Organization)**, and **WTO (World Trade Organization)**.
 
• The summit was held in **Geneva, Switzerland**, which serves as the headquarters for these organizations.
 
• The summit aimed to enhance cooperation between global health, intellectual property, and trade bodies to address contemporary challenges.
 
• Discussions focused on improving access to medicines, innovation, and equitable trade policies worldwide.
 
• Geneva's role as a diplomatic hub makes it a frequent venue for important international summits and negotiations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The WHO, WIPO, and WTO are all specialized agencies of the United Nations system based in Geneva.
 
• Geneva has been a long-standing center for international diplomacy, hosting multiple UN agencies and international organizations.
 
• The summit symbolizes the increasing interconnection of health, trade, and intellectual property in global governance.
 
• It reflects ongoing efforts to streamline policies and frameworks among the three organizations to better tackle global issues.

questions.question:
Consider the following statements regarding the recently test-fired** Prithvi-II **and **Agni-1 Missiles:**

1. Both are short-range ballistic missile developed under the Integrated Guided Missile Development Program.

2. Both are driven by Solid-fueled propulsion.

3. Both play a pivotal role in India’s nuclear deterrence posture.

Which of the above statements is/are ***correct***?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**3 only​.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] In News__**

__
 
• **In July 2025, India successfully conducted test-firing of two ballistic missiles, Prithvi-II and Agni-1**, as part of routine strategic exercises carried out by the Strategic Forces Command (SFC) from Chandipur, Odisha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prithvi-II** is a **short-range ballistic missile__ (SRBM)** with a range of around **350 kilometers**. It is a __**liquid-fueled**__ missile capable of delivering **500 kg conventional or nuclear warheads**.
 
• **Agni-I** is a __**medium-range ballistic missile**__ with a range between **700–900 km**, and in some cases up to **1,200 km**. It uses __**solid fuel**__ and is launched from **road and rail mobile platforms**.
 __
 
• Hence, both **statements 1 and 2 are INCORRECT.**
 
 
 
• Both missiles are **nuclear-capable**__ and are part of India’s **strategic deterrence forces** that ensure national security through second-strike capabilities.
 __
 
• Hence, s**tatement 3 is CORRECT.**
 
 
 
• The successful testing highlights India's focus on maintaining a robust and credible **nuclear deterrence** under the doctrine of **No First Use (NFU)** and reflects the operational readiness of the **Strategic Forces Command**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Prithvi-II**__

 __
 
• Developed under India’s **Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme (IGMDP)** led by **Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam**.
 
• It was the first missile to be developed under this program and is designed for **battlefield use**.
 
• Uses an **inertial navigation system (INS)** for improved accuracy.
 
 
 
• **Agni-I**__
 __
 
• Inducted into the Indian Army in the early 2000s to bridge the gap between **Prithvi** and **Agni-II** missiles.
 
• It is known for its high **mobility and quick deployment capability**.
 
• Acts as a deterrent against regional threats, especially in **South Asia**.
 
 
 
• **Strategic Forces Command (SFC)**__
 
 
• It is a tri-services command responsible for managing and administering all of India's **strategic and nuclear weapons**.
 
• Formed in **January 2003**, it functions under the aegis of the **Nuclear Command Authority (NCA)**.

questions.question: Who received the 43rd Lokmanya Tilak National Award?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Nitin Gadkari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Minister Gadkari honoured with 43rd Lokmanya Tilak National Award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Union Minister Nitin Gadkari** was honoured with the **43rd Lokmanya Tilak National Award** in **Pune**.

 
 
• 
 
The award is presented by the **Lokmanya Tilak Smarak Trust** for **significant contributions to national progress**.

 
 
• 
 
The award includes a **cash prize of ₹1 lakh** and a **citation**.

 
 
• 
 
It was **instituted in 1983** by the **Tilak Smarak Mandir Trust** to honour **Bal Gangadhar Tilak**, also known as **Lokmanya Tilak**.

 
 
• 
 
It is presented **every year on August 1**, the **death anniversary of Tilak**.

 
 
• 
 
The **42nd recipient** (2024) was **Sudha Murty** – for contributions in **rural development, literature, and social work**.

 
 
• 
 
**PM Narendra Modi** received it before Murty for **exceptional leadership and patriotism**.

 
 
• 
 
Other past recipients include:
 **Pranab Mukherjee, Atal Bihari Vajpayee, Indira Gandhi, Manmohan Singh, Sharad Pawar, Rahul Bajaj, Cyrus Poonawalla, Verghese Kurien, M.S. Swaminathan, Sheila Dikshit, Tessy Thomas**, and others.

questions.question: NASA Fast-Tracks Plans to Build Nuclear Reactor on the Moon by 2030. What is the capacity of the nuclear reactor NASA plans to build on the moon?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**100 kilowatts**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• NASA Fast-Tracks Plans to Build Nuclear Reactor on the Moon by 2030.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**NASA** plans to **fast-track** the construction of a **nuclear reactor** on the **moon** by **2030** as part of its broader goal to establish a permanent human base.

 
 
• 
 
The reactor will have a **100-kilowatt** capacity, which is smaller than on-shore **wind turbines** that generate **2-3 megawatts**.

 
 
• 
 
**China** and **Russia** also have plans to build **automated nuclear power stations** on the moon by **2035**.

 
 
• 
 
Other countries, including **India** and **Japan**, are racing to explore the lunar surface and establish **permanent human settlements**.

questions.question: Which Indian state has released the State Policy for Transgender Persons, 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• T.N.’s policy for transgender persons advocates for amending Hindu Succession Act over inheritance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Tamil Nadu** has unveiled the **State Policy for Transgender Persons, 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
A key proposal is to **amend the Hindu Succession Act, 1956** to ensure **equal inheritance rights** for **transgender and intersex persons**.

 
 
• 
 
The **Hindu Succession Act** currently recognizes **heirs only as male or female**.

 
 
• 
 
**Non-binary and gender-diverse identities** are **excluded** from succession rights unless they identify as **male or female**.

 
 
• 
 
As a result, **transgender persons** are often **denied property rights** within their families.

 
 
• 
 
This leads to issues like **homelessness** and **economic insecurity** among the **transgender community**.
